newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA says Bank Austria win may hurt share price.
newsitem.headline: CA says Bank Austria win may hurt share price.

text.p: Creditanstalt chief executive Guido Schmidt-Chiari said on Thursday a majority acquisition of the bank's shares by rival Bank Austria may hurt Creditanstalt's share price.
Asked about the effects of a possible takeover by rival Bank Austria, Schmidt-Chiari told a news conference:

"The precise effect on the share price cannot be estimated with certainty, but judging from other companies which have come under the control of a majority owner, the potential (for the shares) is certainly limited."
Creditanstalt has repeatedly come out against a possible takeover from Bank Austria.
The Austrian state is trying to sell off its 70 percent controlling stake in Creditanstalt.
Bank Austria has submitted the highest offer for the stake at 16.8 billion schillings followed by an international consortium led by Italian-controlled EA-Generali.
The consortium had offered around 13.8 billion schillings but increased its bid on Wednesday. EA-Generali declined to reveal details of the increase.

The deadline for improved offers expires on Friday and Finance Minister Viktor Klima has said he would announce his choice of a victor as soon as possible afterwards, but has given no precise date. -- Vienna newsroom -- +43-1 531-12250
